Hi Rina —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up front, then details below: 

- Yes, we can provide a streaming delivery option for audit logs (Kafka-compatible push or S3 event sync). We guarantee availability consistent with your SLA tier; typical throughput we see is 200–500 MB/min for audit traffic for accounts of your size.
- We attached a recommended evidence_manifest CSV schema and an example export.
- Seat/throughput uplift pricing: I'll loop in Kimberly for the commercial numbers and Karhtik for the onboarding/ops impact.

Detailed notes: 
- Streaming: We support two delivery modes: a near-real-time webhook/Kafka stream with 1–2s delivery latency and an S3 batch export every 15 minutes. Both include sequence numbers and SHA256 checksums. If you need strict immutability we can sign objects and retain full audit trails.
- Retention: Base retention on hosted plan is 90 days for audit logs; we can extend to 365 days as a paid retention add-on.

Attachment: redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.csv (CSV, 3 KB)

Next steps: Kimberly will share a pricing delta for 2x seats + burst capacity and Karhtik will propose a short evidence-handoff runbook. I can set a 30-minute sync with your team next week.

Best,

Rina —

Thanks for the ask. Operationally here is a short runbook I propose for the evidence handoff: 

1) Pre-sprint (2 weeks): we provision a sandbox S3 bucket and a Kafka topic for you to validate schema and checksum flows. We will share sample records (see attached log schema).
2) Sprint week: we enable streaming for a 14-day dry run; we provide a delta manifest daily and an end-of-day digest.
3) Audit handoff: we produce a signed manifest and a final export package (tar.gz) with checksums and sequence numbers.

Notes on retention: scoped 365d retention for the audit project will add ~0.4 TB/month at your current volume. We can route older segments to your S3 with lifecycle rules if you prefer to preserve costs.

Attachments: log_delivery_schema_v2.jsonl (NDJSON, 6 KB), runbook_example.md (MD, 4 KB)

I'll set up the sandbox and a short run of the stream on Mon 8/24 unless you ask otherwise.
